name: BlueObject
summary: The calculator companion this store installs through.
description:
BlueObject runs on the calculator and does the installing. It talks to this page over the USB cable, writes the variables, and keeps the record of what is installed and at what version.

It is itself a C program and loads five of the shared libraries -- graphics, the keypad, files, serial and USB -- so the C Libraries have to be on the calculator for it to start at all. Removing them stops BlueObject running, and BlueObject is what installs things, so that is not a hole you can climb out of from here.

It updates itself through BLUEUP, a second program small enough to be rebuilt from nothing. A program on this calculator runs inside its own variable and cannot overwrite itself, so the two install each other.

install.text: Quit BlueObject and run prgmBLUEUP once to finish the update. Until you do, the calculator keeps running the version it started with.

uninstall.text: Removing BlueObject leaves nothing on the calculator that can install or remove anything else. Everything already installed keeps working, but this page will not be able to reach it again until BLUE.8xp is sent back with TI Connect CE.
